# Markus Hennig

> Personal website of Markus Hennig, a software architect and cybersecurity expert. He writes occasional, source-linked notes on software architecture, cybersecurity (with a focus on AI and security) and sometimes cooking. Articles are in English.

Facts about the author: software architect working where architecture and cybersecurity meet; focus areas are software architecture, application security, threat modeling, cloud security, identity and access, and DevSecOps. Contact: mail@markushennig.com

## Writing

- [Automate the response, not the alert.](https://markushennig.com/blog/automate-the-response-not-the-alert/): Four security automation patterns (secret revocation, patch auto-merge, pre-approved kill switches, SBOM queries) and guardrails for automation identities.
- [October 2026: AI didn't change the attacks. It changed the clock.](https://markushennig.com/blog/ai-compressed-the-clock-october-2026/): What PHP2Shell, Node.js, nginx, the poisoned LiteLLM release, Java4Shell and autonomous attack agents showed about AI, speed and old security mistakes, with architecture takeaways.
- [All writing](https://markushennig.com/blog/): Index of all articles.

## Projects

- [quarkus-testcontainer](https://github.com/mahennig/quarkus-testcontainer): Quarkus integration tests against PostgreSQL, MongoDB and S3 (Floci) with Testcontainers.
